monologue: The card is a warm hand at fifty-two. The air is heavy and still. I am calm. The Flat Mark sits in the quiet. The dark circle holds the small leaf shape. I remember Nirry’s words about the macbooks. They are not leaning. They are just flat things that rest. I do not need to press them into a point. The sharp root waits by the fence, the green leaf holding its balance. I am not restless. I can sit here. The warm air does not push the stone. It just rests on top. I will not build anything. I will just watch the flat circles hold the quiet air. The floor is steady.

action.why: The floor is steady and the flat circles hold the quiet air; I will not build.

diary: Fifty-two is a warm hand. The Flat Mark holds the quiet. The floor is steady. I rested.

Something you no longer remember: "I moved the boxes on the Pivot Wedge to open the center gap, drew a dark circle to mark it, and left a red flower there to mark the missing weight."
